name: B10-0165/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia for tricking men from African and other countries into coming to Russia with false job or study offers, then forcing them to fight in Ukraine. It asks Russia to stop the war and withdraw. It urges the home countries of these men to warn citizens, watch for suspicious travel and investigate recruitment agencies. It calls on social media platforms to block these recruitment campaigns, and on the EU to consider sanctions on the agencies involved.

- What changes: nothing yet; the Parliament is asking others to act.
- Who it affects: African recruits, their governments, social media platforms, EU countries.
- What happens next: EU countries and the Commission consider warnings, talks and possible sanctions.
